business_service_specialization.label: Business-service specialization
business_service_specialization.value: Online talent marketplaces for technology and security-cleared professionals (Dice, ClearanceJobs)

service_operating_model.label: Service operating model
service_operating_model.value: Subscription-based online job board / recruiter database access platforms with AI-powered matching

charging_unit.label: Charging unit
charging_unit.value: Recruitment packages: job postings and recruiter access to candidate database, sold per package or subscription

customer_contract_term.label: Customer contract term
customer_contract_term.value: Mostly fixed-term subscriptions, typically annual or shorter, with some monthly packages

contracted_repeat_revenue.label: Contracted / repeat revenue
contracted_repeat_revenue.value: Majority of revenue from recurring subscription recruitment packages, renewed by employers and recruiters

software_deployment_737_software_service.label: Software deployment [737 software/services]
software_deployment_737_software_service.value: Cloud-hosted online marketplace platforms accessed via web

software_functional_scope_737.label: Software functional scope [737]
software_functional_scope_737.value: Talent marketplace, candidate search and AI skills-based matching for recruiting

staffing_placement_model_736.label: Staffing / placement model [736]
staffing_placement_model_736.value: Recruitment marketplace and job-board access for employers; not placement or staffing agency

notes: Pricing, contract terms and retention are not in the evidence; the values rely on general knowledge of DHI's recruitment-package subscription model.
